name: Fun'ya no Yasuhide
source:
Hobby: Bad Jokes

As a Waka poet who likes putting paronomasia into his Waka, Yasuhide hopes to make people happy with his Waka.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/miyabi.html]English official site[/url]]
